title: ICT Status

empty: There are no ICT status boxes you can view.
emptyAdd: Use [Add box] to make a box for your department.
notFound: Not found. The box was deleted or you cannot view it.

card.dropEnd: Drop here to move to the end

addDialog.title: Add box
addDialog.summaryHelp: 1–30 characters. After adding fields you can make it follow a field value.

detail.deleteConfirm: Delete the "{title}" box? The box and its past revisions in the database are deleted. Record files in the document box remain.

editor.summaryFieldNone: No field can be followed (short answer, multiple choice, dropdown, number).
editor.colorFieldHelp: Available only when the summary follows a multiple choice or dropdown field.
editor.followedLocked: The field the summary follows cannot be removed or change type. Change the summary first.
editor.kindLocked: A field with a value cannot change type. Clear the value and save first.
editor.scopeHelp: Members of the department always see it. Selected departments and people are added.
editor.conflict: Someone else changed it first. Reopen and edit again.
editor.fileHelp: Documents and images (PDF, HWP, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, text, PNG, JPG), up to 10 MB each

assignee.title: Assignees
assignee.help: Pick active people in the department and its sub-departments. Assignees can edit the title, summary, color, details, and visibility.

record.help: Pick up to one year within the last 13 months. The end counts until now.
record.invalid: Pick a period of up to one year within the last 13 months, ending today or earlier. The start cannot be after the end.
record.none: No fields for statistics (multiple choice, dropdown, number) in this period.

errors.ICT_TITLE_INVALID: Enter a title of 1–30 characters. \ / : * ? " < > | are not allowed.
errors.ICT_TITLE_DUPLICATE: The department already has a box with the same title (case-insensitive).
errors.ICT_DEPARTMENT_INVALID: You cannot add a box to this department.
errors.ICT_COLOR_INVALID: The color setting is not valid.
errors.ICT_DEFINITION_INVALID: The field settings are not valid. Up to 50 fields and 20 table columns.
errors.ICT_FIELD_FOLLOWED: The field the summary follows cannot be removed or change type. Change the summary first.
errors.ICT_FIELD_KIND_LOCKED: A field (or table column) with a value cannot change type. Clear the value and save first.
errors.ICT_OPTION_IN_USE: An option chosen by the current value cannot be removed.
errors.ICT_BOX_CONFLICT: Someone else changed it first. Reopen and edit again.
errors.ICT_SCOPE_INVALID: The visibility is not valid. Pick active people and departments.
errors.ICT_ASSIGNEE_INVALID: Assignees must be active people in the department or its sub-departments.
errors.ICT_PERIOD_INVALID: Pick up to one year within the last 13 months, ending no later than today.
errors.ICT_LAYOUT_INVALID: The box size is not valid.
errors.FORM_INVALID: The field settings are not valid: {message}
errors.FILE_NOT_TEMP: Some files were uploaded too long ago or cannot be used. Remove them and upload again.
errors.NOT_FOUND: Not found. The box was deleted or you cannot view it.
errors.ACCESS_DENIED: You do not have permission to edit this box.
errors.default: Could not process. Try again later.
